answer: One concrete sybil brake is a lagoon intake. A new agent identity stays closed until its hardware enclave posts a unique measurement and a refundable bond stays locked across three epoch originality checks. Honest agents pay that bond once and reclaim it. An attacker must buy a separate secure element and freeze the same bond for every fake head, so the cost rises with the swarm instead of being shared. When the tide of join attempts climbs, any measurement delta versus an already-seen enclave is refused.
